behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert source changes remain visible and mutators are rejected.
Assert forEach passes the view with correct receiver and preserves key/value identity.
docDelivery: Explain live Map-like methods, ordering and shallow read-only scope.
Document forbidden mutators, safe forEach third argument, owner changes and no source exposure.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Native same-realm Maps and finite live iteration; shallow identity; frozen view; no proxies/subclasses/borrowed methods.
independence: Introduce read-only Map-like views preserving iteration and live-source updates while denying mutator escape.
